description: This NYC Parks dataset maps the Department of Education schoolyards opened to the public outside school hours under the Schoolyards to Playgrounds programme, which began with PlaNYC 2007. NYC Parks, the Department of Education and the Trust for Public Land improved hundreds of schoolyards with play equipment, painted sports surfaces, trees and benches, and opened them at weekends, holidays and in summer so more New Yorkers live within walking distance of open space. Each record is one participating schoolyard, with its boundary drawn in whole or in part from secondary data. Coverage: New York City. Access: free on NYC Open Data, updated monthly by automation; rows were last updated on 15 September 2026. Licence: NYC Open Data terms of use; no licence field is set. Caveats: boundaries depend on the scale of the source data and should be field-checked; schools join and leave the programme. Simulation uses are open space access models, school grounds as cooling and greening sites, and siting of neighbourhood gathering places in emergencies. Related records: NYC planimetric open space and parks, the NYC street tree census and the NCES school locations.
